author: Adam Savage’s Tested
description:
Adam examines the original Multipass prop from The Fifth Element! We're surprised by a few things from this iconic prop: its weight and construction, printed details we've never seen on the back, as well as a lighting element. Plus, Adam and Brandon from Propstore take a look at another beautiful blaster from Men in Black 3!

Learn more about this prop and the upcoming Propstore EMLA auction: https://propstoreauction.com/auctions/info/id/525
See all the props and costumes in this auction in the catalog: https://propstoreauction.com/auctions/catalog/id/525

Shot by Joey Fameli and edited by Norman Chan
